use_case_details: Primary: chat-based support agent that can call internal tools (ticket lookup, account status) with sub-500ms token streaming target for UI responsiveness
Secondary: onboarding assistant and in-app product recommendations with reranking/embeddings for retrieval
Expected QPS: 20-60 concurrent active chats at peak, typical session length 80-200 tokens; planning to scale to 200 concurrent within 12 months
technical_requirements: Streaming responses with client-side token stream handling
Function/tool calling integration to backend APIs (secure connector + per-call audit logs)
Regional routing: NA and EU endpoints with <50ms inter-region added latency target for EU users
Fallback policies: automatic fallbacks to lower-capacity model variants or alternate region when capacity constrained
SLAs around 95th/99th percentile tail latency, plus transparency on queuing/batching behavior
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks) - Hosted API pilot in NA region: implement streaming + tool calling for a subset of support flows; measure 95th/99th token latency
Phase 2 (2 weeks) - EU region pilot: deploy region routing, compare tail latency vs NA and adjust kernel/quantization settings
Phase 3 (2-4 weeks) - Scale test & reliability: run load tests to validate fallback policies, burst behavior, and autoscaling
Success metrics: 95th token latency <500ms for streaming UI, end-to-end request latency for tool calls <800ms, error rate <0.5%, cost per monthly active user within forecast
